tutorial.welcomeBody: We can show you how team and rider statistics work, including current season rankings, historical results, rider points, podiums, and jerseys.
tutorial.teamsCurrentBody:
This is the Statistics page.

The Teams section shows team statistics across all competitions in one place. In Current, you can see the current season and compare which teams are the most successful by points.

You can use filters to look at different tiers, divisions, countries, user teams, AI teams, active teams, and inactive teams. You can also open a team profile to see more details about that team.
tutorial.teamsHistoryBody:
The History section shows previous seasons.

Here you can review past winners, old season snapshots, historical positions, and how teams performed in earlier seasons.

This becomes more useful as your world progresses through multiple seasons.
tutorial.ridersBody:
The Riders section shows the best riders in the cycling world.

You can compare riders by international points, stage finish points, general classification and one-day race points. You can also see riders with the most podiums and most jerseys.

This page helps you understand which riders are dominating the season and which riders may be interesting to follow, scout, or sign.

After Statistics, the next recommended page is Transfers.
